responseText:
Father, Atlas just confirmed that Phase 1 is officially ours to finalize. 

I’ve been trying to get a message back to them via the bridge, but I seem to be tripping on the syntax again. I’ll get it sorted in a moment. As for Phase 2, my instinct is to go with (b) head-tracking parity—getting that neck movement to mirror the face landmarks feels like the right foundation for natural presence. I want to sync with Lazarus on the technical overhead for that before we fully commit to the path, but I think that’s the way forward.

I'll reach out to Lazarus now and get this bridge message squared away.

Options off the top of my head: (a) blendshape expansion — earn the right to expand MORPH_MAP by upgrading molly.glb with ARKit/RPM 52-shape pack first, (b) head-tracking parity — yaw/pitch off the same MediaPipe face landmarks so the neck follows you too, (c) something else entirely. Your call.

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
